description: Searches authorized estimates using bounded customer, status, title, and total fields; notes, terms, and addresses are excluded. Use to search quotes in the connected business. Returns query, count, total, quotes, resolution, scope.

customer_id.description: Restrict results to one customer ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of estimates to return.

query.description: Estimate title, customer name, email, or phone.

name: search-quotes

query.description: Query used or returned by this tool.

quotes.description: Bounded quotes records returned by this tool.

resolution.description: Resolution metadata; empty collections retain their existing JSON array representation.

scope.description: Authorization scope of this result; data remains restricted to the connected business.

title: Search Quotes Tool
